title: Phase, interference and error correction in native Fold circuits
description:
Exact phase restoration, complete interference predecessor records and the unique first correcting width 2t+1 at every positive finite fault order.

Maria Smith derives native Fold circuit inversion, complete support and observation reconstruction, every-mask majority correction, constructive failure at every smaller width and exact recovery-to-circuit composition. Includes complete original grammar tables, constructive exhaustion and uniqueness proofs, full mathematical arguments, 458 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations, pinned V3/V4 sources and portable exact-output reproduction.

Correspondence: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. SFT community: Discord invitation.

Source and native proofs: SFT V4 verified corpus on GitHub.
